_about: PERFUME HERO ANCHORS (#443 amendment, Danny). The ONLY products the Perfumes carousel may show at full price: iconic bottles Peruvians recognize on sight. Curated few, not a category -- every entry is named and reviewed here. scripts/build-perfumes-shelf.mjs places an entry only when that exact product (brand + every titleAll phrase, none of titleNone) is in a live, on-sale-channel catalogue in the repo; an entry with no such listing simply does not appear. Never add a listing here: add a product name, and let a real catalogue row decide. Flankers (Intense, Elixir, Absolu, Parfum, minis, sets, travel sprays) are excluded by titleNone so the anchor is the bottle people actually picture.

anchors.name: Paco Rabanne 1 Million Eau de Toilette
anchors.why: The gold ingot bottle; the best-known men's designer fragrance in Peru's department stores and duty-free.

anchors.name: Carolina Herrera 212 (Men / Women / VIP)
anchors.why: Carolina Herrera's 212 family is the most-recognized designer line in Latin America; the 212 VIP bottle is an icon.

anchors.name: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Eau de Parfum
anchors.why: The stiletto bottle; a top-selling women's fragrance in the region, recognized on sight.

anchors.name: Creed Aventus Eau de Parfum
anchors.why: The most famous luxury men's fragrance worldwide. The flanker Absolu Aventus is NOT this product and does not qualify.

anchors.name: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Eau de Parfum
anchors.why: Global best seller; the black glitter bottle is as recognized in Lima as 212 or 1 Million.

anchors.name: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum
anchors.why: One of the best-selling women's fragrances in the world since 2019; the gold-cassandre bottle is recognized on sight.

anchors.name: Dior Sauvage Eau de Toilette
anchors.why: The best-selling men's fragrance in the world; same fame tier as 1 Million.

anchors.name: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio
anchors.why: The classic men's designer fragrance in Peru for two decades.
